en: A colorized vintage view of a large steel truss bridge crossing a wide river. In the foreground there is a riverside area with sand or gravel, carts, barrels, and small wooden structures on the water. A paddle steamer and other boats are moored near the bank. The bridge has multiple arched truss spans on brick piers. Printed text on the image reads "Riesa." in the upper left and "Elbbrücke." in the upper right. On one of the boats a sign with the word "RIESA" is visible.
